title: Ancient chess pieces in Mongolian burial mounds as an alien gift
summary: Kiran Ilum Xenov tells of Ancient chess pieces in Mongolian burial mounds as an alien gift, about More than 5,000 years ago at Mongolia; Peru, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Mongolia, there are archaeological excavations, burial mounds, and in one of these burial mounds, they actually found these kinds of figures, some of which are more than 5,000 years old.

plain: A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov, introduced on Jesse Michels's podcast in 2025 as the president of a Russian republic who says he was taken by aliens in 1997, talks about ancient burial mounds in Mongolia. He says chess-like figures were found in one of them, some more than 5,000 years old, and he presents them as a gift from aliens, which would mean visitors shaped human culture long ago.
